title: Great baritone, alto horn and tuba players
summary: He names fine brass-band baritone, alto horn and tuba players, including Adolph Alexander, Eddie Jackson and a Dukes of Dixieland tubist.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Coleman Hawkins and the great saxophonists

blocks.x: I was wondering about some of your favorites on instruments like the baritone horn. Oh, my favorite instruments. Oh, from like the brass band today?
Yeah, some of the brass bands. Oh yeah, well the brass band, I mean, I ain't got no brass band on me.
You couldn't call them a brass band.

No, but I mean, who were some of the great baritone players of the brass band? Oh, like old man Adolph Alexander, that's Tatan, old man, we would call him Tatan, you know. And we had Georgia Hooker across the river and you had Vic Gaspar, you had Eddie Ackage, you had one of them was good baritone, good baritone players they call that. Called Vic Gaspar, he was good.
Did you? Oh man Adolphinson was about the best like that bunch.
Were there any good Anilton players there?

Well yeah, they had Joe Payan, he was a good Anilton player. And Pete Boccage, he's a good Anilton player. And my daddy, he's a pretty good Anilton player. And that's about all I can think of, presents.
What about tuba? They have any good tuba players?

Tuba, yeah. Well they had Jackson, I can't think of the guy, not any of Jackson, another Jackson. He was good. They had Oak Gaspar, he was a good tuba player. Later on in years came a very good tuba player. What everybody knew was that. He was a little slim fella. Tall and slim. That was Eddie Jackson. You could hear Eddie Jackson one mile off. One mile off. He wasn't a big guy, huh? He wasn't a big guy, no. Slim man. Very small man. Thin man. Tall. Did he play good besides being high? Yeah, he played good, yeah. There's no tuba players today. That's the only thing we don't have on the street. I'll tell you a good tuba player. I don't know what the boy's name, but that boy played with the Dukes of Dixieland.
I made some recording with the Dukes of Dixieland.
That man is a great tuba player. That man is a great tuba player. It must build poor.
Yeah. The guy Lowell Miller with the...
I don't know, you know that boy that Dukes and Dixon, that man played some tuba, man. Well that's my type of a tuba player.
Yeah, one there, one there, I mean Bernard Mallon too, that was a tuba player.
He's from here. Oh, all of them are good.
